title: The Archive of Scents
subtitle: Aesop Jeju: Where literature ends and fragrance begins.
line: A quiet sanctuary where the scent of aged paper lingers amidst volcanic stone.
quote: An olfactory library carved from the breath of Jeju.
synopsis: You step into a space that feels like a forgotten archive, where the walls are composed of dark Jeju stone. The central stone basin serves as the anchor, inviting you to perform a silent, ritualistic cleansing that cleanses the mind as well as the hands. As you follow the path, the warmth of the shelves replaces the cold stone, guiding you through a collection of scents that mirror the depth of a library. Each step here is a journey through memory and scent, sheltered from the world outside.

why.t: The shelf walls define the boundaries of the
why.d: Shelf walls (Shelves for fragrance bottles) wrap the left, right and back of the 12 x 10 m room. The shelf walls define the boundaries of the room, creating an immersive, book-like enclosure for the product.

why.t: The central stone basin acts as the primary
why.d: The centre object (The central stone basin) is the first stop, 4.2 m in from the door. The central stone basin acts as the primary sensory focal point, grounding your visit in a moment of quiet reflection.
The route circles it first, then follows the shelves. The circulation encourages a contemplative pace, moving from the cleansing ritual to the discovery of the scents.

why.t: The counter at the back provides a final
why.d: The counter (Service counter at the back) sits at the back, off the loop. The counter at the back provides a final, grounded point for interaction before you complete your journey.

materials.name: Basalt Black Stone
materials.where: walls, the central stone basin, service counter at the back

stops.cap: I stand before the silent basin, the heart of this stone sanctuary.
stops.sub: The water ripples against the dark, grounding volcanic rock.

stops.cap: I graze the wooden shelves, tracing scents like spines of books.
stops.sub: Fragrance replaces ink in this archive of Jeju memories.

stops.cap: I pause at the back, feeling the stillness of the library.
stops.sub: A quiet ritual completed in the shadow of the cooling light.
